question.problem:
Which of the following vector spaces has a dimension of $16?$

I. ${R}_{15}[t]$, the vector space of all polynomials in the variable $t$ of degree at most $15$

II. ${\text{M}}_{4}(R)$, the vector space of all $4\times 4$ matrices over $R$

III. ${R}^{15}$
question.worked_solution:
Let's examine each of the vector spaces in turn.

I. Recall that $\text{dim}({R}_{n}[t])=n+1.$ Therefore, 

  $$
  \text{dim}({R}_{15}[t])=15+1=16.\,✓
  $$

II. Recall that $\text{dim}({\text{M}}_{n}(\text{R}))={n}^{2}.$ Therefore, 

  $$
  \text{dim}({\text{M}}_{4}(R))={4}^{2}=16.\,✓
  $$

III. Recall that $\text{dim}({R}^{n})=n.$ Therefore, 

  $$
  \text{dim}({R}^{15})=15\ne 16.\,\times 
  $$

Hence, the correct answer is "I and II only."
